verdict.rationale: Casium presents itself as a technology platform with a client portal, so official SDKs are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions any SDK, API, or developer documentation. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs, and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so there is no evidence of official SDKs to build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
